column1: # The labs' external models (D-048): the Khronos glTF sample assets at one commit, fetched by
# tools/fetch-assets.sh into assets/external/, which git ignores. For the labs and the tests
# only: nothing that ships reads assets/external/ (credits --check fails if it does).
# @ lines are models: name, use, licence, artists. `open` models are CC0 or CC-BY 4.0 and are
# fetched by default; `reference` models are under restricted licences, fetched only with
# --reference-only, and never in the engine or a game.
# Other lines are files: model, path under Models/ in the repository, bytes, SHA-256.

column5: PixelMannen (model), tomkranis (rigging and animation), AsoboStudio and scurest (glTF conversion)
Crytek; Frank Meinl after Marko Dabrovic
